def validate_vba_metadata(archive):
    # Match the native OOXML workbook and the one standard VBA part, never just the suffix.
    from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

    def metadata(path):
        info = archive.getinfo(path)
        if info.file_size > 1 << 20:
            raise ValueError("archive_workbook_metadata_size")
        text = archive.read(info).decode("utf-8-sig")
        if "<!DOCTYPE" in text.upper() or "<!ENTITY" in text.upper():
            raise ValueError("archive_workbook_xml_declaration")
        return ET.fromstring(text)

    project = "xl/vbaProject.bin"
    markers = ("vbaproject", "macrosheet", "activex", "embeddings")
    ct = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types}"
    rel = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}Relationship"
    types = metadata("[Content_Types].xml")
    workbook_types = [node.get("ContentType", "").lower() for node in types.findall(ct + "Override")
                      if node.get("PartName") == "/xl/workbook.xml"]
    if workbook_types != ["application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.main+xml"]:
        raise ValueError("archive_workbook_type_mismatch")
    active_types = [node for node in types if any(x in node.get("ContentType", "").lower() for x in markers)]
    if any(node.get("ContentType", "").lower() != "application/vnd.ms-office.vbaproject" or not (
             (node.tag == ct + "Default" and node.get("Extension") == "bin") or
             (node.tag == ct + "Override" and node.get("PartName") == "/" + project)) for node in active_types):
        raise ValueError("archive_active_workbook_content_type")
    relationships = metadata("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels")
    active_rels = [node for node in relationships.findall(rel) if any(
        x in (node.get("Type", "") + node.get("Target", "")).lower() for x in markers)]
    if any(node.get("Type") != "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/relationships/vbaProject"
           or node.get("TargetMode") not in (None, "Internal")
           or node.get("Target") not in ("vbaProject.bin", "/" + project) for node in active_rels):
        raise ValueError("archive_active_workbook_relationship")
    expected = int(project in archive.namelist())
    if not len(active_types) == len(active_rels) == expected:
        raise ValueError("archive_inconsistent_workbook_vba_metadata")

BATCH_SCHEMA = "citrus.fusion-reference-batch/1"
BATCH_STATUSES = {"verified", "metadata_conflict", "retracted", "unconfirmed", "not_found",
                  "source_unavailable", "not_processed"}


def batch_report(response, rows, batch):
    if batch is None:
        if rows:
            response["status"] = "partial"
            response["limitations"].append("reference extraction only; no registry was queried")
        response["records"] = [dict(record_index=index, submitted=entry, status="not_processed", attempts=[])
                               for index, entry in enumerate(rows, start=1)]
        return response
    records = batch.get("records")
    if (batch.get("schema") != BATCH_SCHEMA or not isinstance(records, list) or len(records) != len(rows)
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", batch.get("original_report_sha256", ""))):
        raise ValueError("invalid_binding_for_reference_batch")
    counts = dict.fromkeys(sorted(BATCH_STATUSES), 0)
    response["records"] = []
    from hashlib import sha256

    for index, (entry, record) in enumerate(zip(rows, records), start=1):
        checked = record.get("status")
        submitted = json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode()
        if (record.get("record_index") != index or checked not in BATCH_STATUSES
                or record.get("submitted_sha256") != sha256(submitted).hexdigest()):
            raise ValueError("invalid_reference_batch_record")
        counts[checked] += 1
        response["records"].append({**record, "submitted": entry, "evidence_ids": [
            item["record_id"] for item in record["attempts"]], "evidence_grade": (
                "registry_match" if checked in {"verified", "retracted"} else "candidate" if record["registered"] else "none")})
        response["coverage"].append(dict(check="identity", scope="metadata in observed registries",
            record_index=index, status=checked, reason=record.get("reason")))
    response["reference_batch"] = {key: batch[key] for key in ("schema", "original_report_sha256", "stop_reason",
        "coverage", "distinct_queries", "provider_requests", "elapsed_ms")}
    response["reference_batch"]["status_counts"] = counts
    response["limitations"].append("Registry metadata and observed retraction signals only; no source full text was fetched.")
    if any(counts[key] for key in ("unconfirmed", "source_unavailable", "not_processed")) or batch.get("stop_reason"):
        response["status"] = "partial"
    return response
